# AG4TE (formerly DevArch Framework; package devarch-framework, command devarch)

> Git repository archaeology framework — mine commit history into evidence-backed engineering reports.

## What it is
A Python framework + CLI that mines a repo's git history, runs 6 analysis vectors, detects signals, and generates engineering/learning reports. ICM-aligned. Also ships as a Hermes Desktop plugin (plugins/ag4te-hermes) that draws a repo's history as strata.

## Install / use
git clone the repo, then `pip install -e .` (not yet on PyPI).

## Links
- Repository: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/ag4te
